svg.title: Tatawwu Bahrain — project design specification
svg.text: Four MongoDB collections · Favorites and certificates are fields inside Campaign
TATAWWU' / BAHRAIN / ENGLISH / MERN + JWT + CLOUDINARY
required; enum: Capital, Northern, Southern, Muharraq,
ref: User (volunteer); default: []; hidden in ordinary
ref: User (volunteer); default: []; hidden in ordinary
enum: Draft, Pending, Approved, Rejected, Removed,
favorites: user IDs of volunteers who saved this campaign.
certificates: user IDs of volunteers who received a certificate for
Both fields reference User. Neither field creates its own collection.
User ↔ Campaign: many-to-many through favorites and certificates
Registration has a unique volunteerId + campaignId pair.
Use $addToSet to add a user ID and $pull to remove it. Do not add a
unique index on the arrays: a volunteer can save or receive
A certificates entry records a granted volunteer ID. It does not store certificate
IDs, PDF files, certificate numbers, issue dates, or issuance snapshots. PDF export
Field tables reflect the backend models. Organization and Registration controllers/routes remain planned.
